newsitem.title: FINLAND: POLL - TT Tieto Jan-June profit seen higher.
newsitem.headline: POLL - TT Tieto Jan-June profit seen higher.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 116 million markka median forecast for information technology group TT Tieto Oy's six-month profit before extraordinary items and tax.
TT Tieto is due to report its first-half results on August 7 at 0900/0600 GMT.
In January-June 1996, TT Tieto had an 85.2 million markka profit before extraordinary items and tax.
In February, TT Tieto said its overall outlook was bright although it saw sales growth evening out in the second quarter.

For the company's full-year 1997 profit, five of the analysts polled gave a median forecast of 242 million markka (mean 245 million) in a 237-256 million markka range. TT Tieto's 1996 profit was 194.3 million markka.
Contributors to the survey were Aktia Bank, Carnegie Securities, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, Interbank and Merita Bank.
